newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee eases vs dlr, weak on NOC demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee eases vs dlr, weak on NOC demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened lower at 57.10/12 rupees per dollar on Friday, compared to the previous close of 57.08 rupees, dealers said.
"The rupee is expected to remain weak in view of $12 million bill for the import of petroleum products by the state-owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC)," a dealer said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 2.85 percent on Friday, against the previous 3.0 percent, a dealer said.
